convention: 0-indexed arrays of 0/1; full length-1024 words stored as strings
RS_def: RS[i] = parity of count of (possibly overlapping) 11 blocks in binary expansion of i; RS[0]=0 (OEIS A020985: 0,0,0,1,0,0,1,0,...)
PF_def: position i = PF(i+1) with m=2^k*u u odd: 0 if u=1 mod 4 else 1 (OEIS A014577: 0,0,1,0,0,1,1,0,...)
